notes.title: 1 Year Anniversary - Permanent Price Reduction for Child of the Wind!
notes.content:
Hello all,

To celebrate the upcoming 1 year aniversary for Child of the Wind, the price of has been permanently reduced from $14.99 USD to [b]$7.99 USD[/b]. 

Enjoy navigating the dangerous waters, smashing enemy ships and collecting lost cargo in this intense VR adventure.

Have a wonderful day and happy sailing,
Oscar

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25314654/8b1ca88adbaa643fe604170ff693ea8fb0333d3a.png[/img]

notes.title: Oculus Rift Support
notes.content:
Thanks to the good folks over at Oculus, support for the Oculus Rift + Touch is in the works and will be released concurrently with the Vive version.
All mechanics of the game are already compatible with a front-facing setup, so there'll be no need to fret about if it'll work natively or not; it'll work perfectly!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25314654/8b1ca88adbaa643fe604170ff693ea8fb0333d3a.png[/img]

notes.title: Closed Beta Test Sign Up!
notes.content:
Good news, everyone! 

We're starting the beta test of Child of the Wind in the next couple weeks and we would love for anyone and everyone with a Vive headset to join in! 

To participate in the Beta, fill out the form below and you'll be in line for a shiny Beta Key. 

Beta Sign up Form: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdaGDf9hE3q2GAmJQhSev0xcW29gN-RmHj7lv_Ow3qMRjdYJA/viewform?usp=sf_link#responses

That's not all! 
Were also giving away some prizes in the form of a free, full copy of the game on release for the most active people who post bug reports and just general feedback on the game. More news on that to come soon. 

Thanks all!
